SELECT
  a.month,
  a.shipments_shipped,
  COALESCE(b.shipments_delivered, 0) AS shipments_delivered,
  b.avg_transit_days,
  b.median_transit_days,
  b.p90_transit_days,
  b.pct_within_3_days,
  ROUND(100.0 * COALESCE(b.shipments_delivered, 0) / a.shipments_shipped, 1) AS pct_delivered
FROM (
  SELECT cd.month_label AS month, COUNT(*) AS shipments_shipped
  FROM shipments s
  JOIN calendar_days cd ON cd.calendar_date = CAST(s.shipped_at AS date)
  WHERE s.carrier = 'Albion Parcel'
    AND s.shipped_at >= DATE '2025-01-01'
    AND s.shipped_at < DATE '2026-01-01'
  GROUP BY cd.month_label
) a
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT
    cd.month_label AS month,
    COUNT(*) AS shipments_delivered,
    ROUND(CAST(AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (s.delivered_at - s.shipped_at)) / 86400.0) AS numeric), 2) AS avg_transit_days,
    ROUND(CAST(PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (s.delivered_at - s.shipped_at)) / 86400.0) AS numeric), 2) AS median_transit_days,
    ROUND(CAST(PERCENTILE_CONT(0.9) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (s.delivered_at - s.shipped_at)) / 86400.0) AS numeric), 2) AS p90_transit_days,
    ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (s.delivered_at - s.shipped_at)) / 86400.0 <= 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 1) AS pct_within_3_days
  FROM shipments s
  JOIN calendar_days cd ON cd.calendar_date = CAST(s.shipped_at AS date)
  WHERE s.carrier = 'Albion Parcel'
    AND s.shipped_at >= DATE '2025-01-01'
    AND s.shipped_at < DATE '2026-01-01'
    AND s.delivered_at IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY cd.month_label
) b ON a.month = b.month
ORDER BY a.month ASC

note: transit_days = delivered_at - shipped_at in days, computed only over the delivered subset per month (shipments_shipped counts all Albion Parcel shipments shipped that month regardless of delivery). As flagged in the request, pct_delivered for the last 1-2 weeks of December will read artificially low because of the 2025-12-31 data cutoff (deliveries still in transit at cutoff aren't yet recorded).
